description: This file defines a JavaScript module that creates an API client for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to a backend server. It handles JWT token forwarding via a provided token-fetching function, constructs request headers, and processes responses including error handling.

methods.name: createApiClient(getTokenFn)
methods.description: Creates and returns an API client object with methods for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests, incorporating JWT token forwarding and dynamic base URL configuration.
